statusDetail: The application is geographically restricted. Browser navigation from this audit host returned an Arabic access-denied page stating that the foreign-currency booking platform can only be accessed from inside Libya; the HTTP response was 403. The target application surface was therefore unavailable.

page.notes: Only a server-rendered geographic access-denied response was visible. The underlying application architecture and routes could not be inspected.
